text:
Grace Kim: Notifying ops: we observed a cascade of GPU preemptions in dedicated-us-central starting 09:22 UTC. Resulted in queued inference requests and ~2-3% timeouts for affected Dedicated customers. Opening incident thread.

Owen Price: Confirmed. Preemptions hit a subset of reserved pools after a noisy low-priority batch job leaked GPU allocations during a node reboot window.

ops-bot: mitigation-run: migrate-pool d-dedicated-usc-3 -> spare-pool-1 initiated by @Owen Price at 09:27 UTC.

Hassan Ali: Immediate mitigations: 1) quarantined noisy batch cluster, 2) migrated ~60 active replicas off impacted hosts, 3) increased scheduler preemption backoff to limit thrash.

Grace Kim: Impact summary: Dedicated customers on reserved pools d-dedicated-usc-3 and d-dedicated-usc-4 saw elevated inference latency and ~2-3% connection timeouts between 09:22-09:35 UTC. Hosted API unaffected. No data corruption.

CS-bot: Draft customer notice posted to #support-digest. Will notify affected accounts and offer mitigation details. Status page stub: https://status.redwood-inference.com/incidents/2915000000

Owen Price: Quick SRE commands for debugging:

```bash
# list nodes with recent preemptions
rdwctl nodes list --pool d-dedicated-usc-* --filter "preemptions>0" --last 30m
# migrate replicas from node
rdwctl compute migrate --node node-usc-42 --pool spare-pool-1 --concurrency 4
```

Hassan Ali: Metrics update: error rate and tail latency started improving by 09:30 UTC and returned to baseline by 09:37 UTC after migrations. We're keeping the scheduler throttle for 20m to avoid re-thrash.

Grace Kim: Root cause hypothesis: a CZAT batch job scheduled during rolling reboot retained GPU handles due to a driver race; when node came back, scheduler preempted inferences aggressively.

Owen Price: Post-incident actions: 1) enforce driver update that fixes handle leak, 2) add scheduler safety window during node reboots, 3) add alert for >5 preemptions/min per pool. I'll open PRs for 1 and 2.

Hassan Ali: I'll draft the technical RCA and include kernel/driver traces. Grace to coordinate customer comms with CS. Target: publish RCA + customer note by EOD.

CS-bot: Affected customers contacted via account teams; offering follow-up call for enterprise tenants.

ops-bot: incident-severity: SEV2 (partial outage for Dedicated customers).

Grace Kim: Thanks all 11 keeping this thread for RCA updates. :white_check_mark:
